descriptions.value: Stack-based buffer overflow in SysInternals allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.
This issue was addressed with additional entitlement checks. This issue is fixed in iOS 26.7.2 and iPadOS 26.7.2, iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2. An app may be able to fingerprint the user.

descriptions.description: An app may be able to fingerprint the user

descriptions.value: A double free issue was addressed with improved memory management. This issue is fixed in macOS Golden Gate 27. An app may be able to cause unexpected system termination.

descriptions.description: An app may be able to cause unexpected system termination
